races.title: KSR Lighting Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Despite failing to win a bumper between them, SMOKEHOUSE and The Mad Poet displayed plenty of ability and they could be the pair to focus on now hurdling. Marginal preference is for the Snowden inmate. Of the rest, point recruit Without Cause has to be of interest. SMOKEHOUSE (IRE) THE MAD POET (IRE) WITHOUT CAUSE (IRE)

races.title: OPC Home Guard Remembrance Handicap Chase
races.verdict: SEA WARRIOR surpassed his hurdling form at first time of asking over fences when a ready winner here 2 weeks ago and his follow-up claims appear to be bright. Ahanaglogh was on the up from his low base when last seen and is a threat on reappearance, along with Koenigsstern . SEA WARRIOR (IRE) AHANAGLOGH (IRE) KOENIGSSTERN (IRE)

races.title: My Laces Cost More Than Your Shoes Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: MILD MAGIC can win again for a yard that excels with her type. In-form I Love You Sivola is the most likely danger, with Docteur Romeo also worth a second look. MILD MAGIC (IRE) I LOVE YOU SIVOLA (FR) DOCTEUR ROMEO (FR)

races.title: Gary Wrights Big 40th Birthday Celebration Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: It may pay to concentrate on SO YOU KNOW and Paso Doble , who both made winning reappearances last season. The former gets the nod on just his second start over a trip that really should suit. He's A Latchico could be a danger, if the market expects him to leave behind a lacklustre comeback run. SO YOU KNOW (IRE) PASO DOBLE (IRE) HE'S A LATCHICO (IRE)

races.title: Mercedes-Benz Of Chichester Handicap Chase
races.verdict: Assuming he copes with a 4-day turnaround, HARD STARE can put his fitness to good use and build on what was a promising chasing debut at Plumpton on Monday. Ted The Thief lacks an outing but is the obvious threat. HARD STARE TED THE THIEF (IRE) SWEET NIGHTINGALE

races.title: Weddings At Fontwell Park Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: WINSTON'S OATH didn't look at home over the fixed-brush obstacles at Southwell 3 weeks ago but that was a pretty strong handicap for the grade and back at the scene of his breakthrough win, he can get back on track. Pippin's Legend and Eyeeye also contested that aforementioned race and showed enough to think they are the main threats. WINSTON'S OATH (IRE) PIPPIN'S LEGEND EYEEYE
